description: Validates measures coverage and per-measure tiering through measures-health.

capabilities.label: Contract Derivation
capabilities.description: Readable measure inputs, CLI manifest access, architecture-derived stateful domains, and illegal-domain detection.

levels.name: No readable measures contract
levels.description: The scenario has not exposed enough structure for measures-health to reason about measures adoption.
levels.capability_summary: Measures Health cannot derive the expected stateful-domain contract.
levels.next_unlock: Readable CLI manifest and repository contract inputs.

levels.name: Expected domains derived
levels.description: Measures Health can derive the scenario's stateful domains from the canonical architecture surface or a documented fallback.
levels.capability_summary: Expected stateful domains can be derived.
levels.next_unlock: Architecture-backed derivation without illegal domain declarations.

levels.name: Contract derivation clean
levels.description: Expected stateful domains are derived from canonical architecture inputs without illegal declarations or fallback debt.

capabilities.label: Domain Coverage
capabilities.description: Expected stateful domains are covered by measures or deliberate waivers, with persisted substrate declarations reconciled.

levels.name: Domain coverage unavailable
levels.description: Expected domains cannot be compared with declared measures or waivers.
levels.next_unlock: Expected domains and persisted substrates are known.

levels.name: Coverage comparable
levels.description: Expected domains can be compared with measure declarations, waivers, and persisted substrates.
levels.capability_summary: Measures coverage can be compared against expected stateful domains.
levels.next_unlock: Every expected domain is covered or deliberately waived.

levels.name: Domains covered or waived
levels.description: Every expected stateful domain has a declared measure or a deliberate waiver.
levels.capability_summary: Expected stateful domains are covered or waived.
levels.next_unlock: Waiver and substrate coverage debt eliminated.

levels.name: Domain coverage clean
levels.description: Domain coverage, waivers, and persisted substrate declarations are clean.

capabilities.label: Declaration Assembly
capabilities.description: Declared measures assemble against their bound proto request schemas.

levels.name: Measure declarations unavailable
levels.description: Declared measures cannot be parsed or assembled.

levels.name: Declarations readable
levels.description: Declared measures can be inspected for proto request bindings.
levels.next_unlock: Valid declaration shape and proto request bindings.

levels.name: Measures assemble
levels.description: Declared measures assemble against their bound proto request schemas.
levels.capability_summary: Measure declarations assemble against their proto bindings.

levels.name: Declaration assembly clean
levels.description: Measure declaration assembly checks are clean.

capabilities.label: Tier Completeness
capabilities.description: Covered domains are backed by full-tier measures with deterministic or bounded parameter extraction.

levels.name: Tier posture unavailable
levels.description: Measure tier posture cannot be evaluated.
levels.next_unlock: Assembled measure declarations with tier metadata.

levels.name: Tier posture visible
levels.description: Measure tiers can be inspected across covered domains.

levels.name: Full-tier coverage
levels.description: Covered domains are backed by full-tier measures with deterministic or bounded parameter extraction.
levels.next_unlock: Tier fallback and partial-tier debt eliminated.

capabilities.label: Behavioral Indexing
capabilities.description: Declared measures pass behavioral probes and are suitable for indexed search and fleet surfaces.

levels.name: Behavioral readiness unavailable
levels.description: Declared measures cannot yet prove behavioral readiness.
levels.next_unlock: Assembled full-tier measures that can be probed.

levels.name: Behavioral probeable
levels.description: Declared measures can be inspected for behavioral probe and index readiness.
levels.capability_summary: Measures can be checked for behavioral and index readiness.

levels.name: Behavioral and indexed
levels.description: Declared measures pass the behavioral probe and are ready for fleet/search surfaces.
levels.capability_summary: Measures are behaviorally ready and indexable.
